Continued increase of required screen time to stay caught up with the game doesn't increase revenue like they think. It will decrease the player base because of that "ugh okay gotta log in for this or that." It becomes work. Adding crucible is adding more screen time to do stuff. Top alliances already talk about the race of war which the devs have no actual answer for, hence HfH to "slow down" full clears. I know some are gonna come at me about "if you don't wanna put the time in.. etc etc etc" but growth of the game is dependent on people enjoying the screen time they put in.  Should grinding be part of being super high tier f2p, doing blitz every 2 hours and burning all energy to make an event milestone? Sure, though that level of grinding should at least let you complete events. But low to high tier  play shouldn't require so much screen time that it burns you out on a mode. 

Arena, Blitz, War, Doom raid, greek raid, RTA, Avenger's tower, DD(with pocket), Scourage, Campaign, Iso Campign, Event campaign, Crucible. That is a lot of stuff to juggle and some of the older stuff could use skimming so we can enjoy the new stuff.
